proof_scope: Memory skill readiness for OpenAI interview recall and store/readback evidence boundaries.

claims.proves: Memory status works and a live OpenAI interview evidence document can be stored and read back through Memory HTTP endpoints.
claims.does_not_prove: direct ArangoDB/Qdrant mutation by application code, semantic ranking quality, or production retention policy.

cases.name: hardening-trace-human-checkpoint-contract
command:
from pathlib import Path
text = Path('../SKILL.md').read_text()
required = ['Mandatory Hardening Trace And Human Checkpoints', 'pipeline_steps[]', 'human_checkpoint', 'CLARIFY', 'DRAFT', 'Unsigned drafts are not answer authority', 'survives two focused repair attempts', '$debugger']
missing = [item for item in required if item not in text]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit('missing mandatory hardening contract text: ' + ', '.join(missing))

cases.name: openai-interview-store-readback
command:
import json, time, urllib.request
key='openai-interview-skill-eval-'+str(int(time.time()*1000))
doc={'_key':key,'schema':'memory.openai_interview_skill_eval.v1','kind':'openai_interview_skill_eval','classification':'internal','tags':['openai-interview','agentic-evals'],'retrieval_text':'OpenAI interview skill-chain Memory store readback proof'}
body=json.dumps({'collection':'project_knowledge','document':doc}).encode()
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8601/store', data=body, headers={'content-type':'application/json'}, method='POST')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r: r.read()
body=json.dumps({'collection':'project_knowledge','filters':{'_key':key},'limit':1}).encode()
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8601/list', data=body, headers={'content-type':'application/json'}, method='POST')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r: out=json.loads(r.read().decode())
assert out['count']==1 and out['documents'][0]['classification']=='internal'
print('MEMORY_OPENAI_READBACK_OK')

capability_claims.description: Memory can answer a scoped OpenAI-interview recall query through the skill entrypoint.
Memory can store and read back a classified OpenAI interview proof document through service endpoints.
